summary: After a failed union vote, coworkers circulate a petition for hazard pay and nearly all sign.
realLife: After a union election was lost, workers petitioned for pandemic hazard pay; most production staff signed, even some who voted no, and the company acted before it was delivered.
sources: Forge Organizing, worker accounts of a food-plant union drive: https://forgeorganizing.org/article/we-wanted-keep-those-jobs/
inGame: job record with employer and workplace; needs: a petition record and an employer-response record

turns.summary: The company grants the pay before the petition is delivered.
The petition is delivered and nothing happens.
turns.writesBack: cynicism mood; talk of stronger action

turns.summary: Some refuse to sign and the break room goes quiet.
